Spezialwaffen und Farbleistung gewinnen: Specials and turf output win this mode – not kills: specials correlate with win rate at r = 0.53, turf at r = 0.47, kills only at r = 0.17 (stat.ink, 107,000 matches).
Erst das eigene Startgebiet vollständig: First paint your starting area completely (safe points + special charge), then head to mid.
Große Flächen und Wände mitnehmen, die G: Take the big areas and walls enemies don't like to touch – don't repaint the contested middle for the fifth time.
Die letzten 30 Sekunden sind das eigentl: The last 30 seconds are the real match: save specials for the finale and secure the biggest areas in the closing seconds.
Nie in der eigenen Zone stehen: Nach dem: Never stand inside your own zone: after capturing, defend AROUND it (control paths and high ground) – a death inside your own zone flips it fastest.
Poken statt committen: Aus sicherer Dist: Poke instead of committing: throw paint/damage from safe range, farm your special – the real retake only happens as a group with 2+ stacked specials or a numbers advantage.
Lockout spielen: Nach gewonnenem Teamfig: Play the lockout: after a won team fight, take the furthest SAFE position (choke points toward mid), not the enemy spawn.
Stabile Holds anstreben: Die Strafpunkte: Aim for stable holds: the penalty-points mechanic punishes constant back-and-forth – whoever holds longer in one stretch wins.
Zwei Spieler reichen zum Halten der meis: Two players are enough to hold most zones – the others take turf and flanks.
Der Kampf passiert VOR und NEBEN dem Tur: The fight happens IN FRONT of and BESIDE the tower, not on it: clear the path first, then ride.
Nur mit Spieler-Vorteil aufsteigen (mind: Only ride with a player advantage (at least +1, ideally +2) – at even numbers, nobody rides.
Genau EIN Fahrer (kurze Reichweite), ein: Exactly ONE rider (short range), one covers beside it, two clear ahead. More riders do NOT make the tower faster (only checkpoints do) – they're just a bigger target.
Spezials für Checkpoints aufheben – die: Save specials for checkpoints – yours for clearing ahead; against enemy stalls, area specials and bombs ONTO the platform are the best retake window.
Fahrer-Technik: Stange als rotierende De: Rider technique: use the pole as rotating cover, jump over horizontal shots, hop off briefly for bombs and get right back on.
Turm-Kontrolle lädt dem ganzen Team pass: Riding the tower passively charges the whole team's special gauge (4.5 p/s) – contest early instead of gifting free progress.
Vor dem Knacken der Barriere sammeln (3+: Group up before breaking the barrier (3+ alive) – popping the barrier when nobody can carry/escort hands the Rainmaker to the enemy.
Träger-Kill ist Priorität Nr. 1: In kein: Killing the carrier is priority #1: in no other mode does kill ratio correlate more strongly with winning (r = 0.36) – every carrier stop resets the push.
Routen vorher kennen und vormalen; Check: Know the routes beforehand and pre-paint them; use checkpoints to regroup safely instead of blindly running through.
Der Träger behält volle Beweglichkeit (a: The carrier keeps full mobility (including the Squid Roll) – the escort runs ahead and paints, the carrier follows protected.
Als Team hinter dem Träger bleiben – ein: Stay behind the carrier as a team – a carrier alone in front of the team is a gift.
Pushes werden VORBEREITET, dann in einem: Pushes are PREPARED, then executed in one window: power clam ready + 2+ specials + 4 alive – no committing before that.
Muscheln vor dem Push sammeln und vertei: Collect and distribute clams before the push – and don't take risky fights while carrying clams (dying scatters them).
Nach dem Korb-Öffnen sofort nachwerfen:: After the basket opens, keep throwing immediately: the open window is the opportunity, not the single hit.
In der Verteidigung Korb-Region halten u: On defense, hold the basket region and disrupt enemy clam collectors instead of chasing wildly.
Immer relativ zur Gefahrenstufe bewerten: Always judge relative to hazard level – the coach converts this automatically.
Top-Teams töten fast alles, was spawnt (: Top teams kill almost everything that spawns (75 of max 97) – weak teams let ~40% of bosses live. Bosses are the egg source.
Der größte Einzelhebel: 3+ Ausfälle pro: The biggest single lever: 3+ downs per shift cost more than anything else.
mehr retten als selbst ausfallen: rescue more than you go down
Auf Top-Niveau fällt schlicht weniger au: At top level people simply go down less – the balance matters, not the absolute number.
Dauerhaft unter 40 % = Gefahrenstufe akt: Consistently below 40% = hazard level currently too high – focus a few shifts on fundamentals.
Selbst Top-Teams sammeln nur ~2/3 der ge: Even top teams only collect ~2/3 of the eggs that spawn – faster egg-running gains more than even more kills.
Die Stufe steigt automatisch mit dem Ran: The level rises automatically with your rank – it IS the most honest progress meter.
Bosse zum Korb LOCKEN und erst dort erle: LURE bosses to the basket and only kill them there – the 3 Golden Eggs then drop next to the basket instead of at the map edge (the single biggest trick for more eggs).
Goldene Eier WERFEN (statt tragen): Der: THROW Golden Eggs (instead of carrying): the egg throw over distance saves trips and rescues quotas in the final seconds – but it costs ink, so refill first.
Prioritäts-Bosse SOFORT töten, sobald si: Kill priority bosses IMMEDIATELY when they spawn: Flyfish (missile launcher) and Stinger (pot tower) shell the whole team across half the map, Drizzler floods the ground – every second they live makes the wave harder.
In Korbnähe zusammenbleiben: 70–80 % der: Stay together near the basket: 70–80% of the time in the middle area – whoever farms alone at the edge dies alone and their eggs expire.
Ausgefallene Kollegen SOFORT wiederbeleb: Revive downed teammates IMMEDIATELY (drop an egg if you must) – every down means 25% less team output and rescues take seconds.
Boden UND Wände rund um den Korb ständig: Keep repainting the ground AND walls around the basket – freedom of movement for the whole team and escape routes at high tide.
Bei Ebbe rechtzeitig mit RAUS ans Wasser: At low tide, move OUT to the water in time; at high tide, take the safe high ground early – tide positioning decides more waves than aim.
Spezialwaffen (2 Einsätze pro Schicht) g: Budget your special weapon uses (2 per shift) deliberately: one for emergencies in wave 1–2, one for wave 3 – don't hoard both, don't burn both instantly.
In Welle 1 und 2 ÜBER die Quote liefern: Deliver ABOVE quota in waves 1 and 2 – the buffer decides whether a hard wave 3 is still enough.
Mit „schlechten“ Waffen-Rotationen trotz: Play 'bad' weapon rotations anyway: top players know every weapon in the rotation – exactly that separates them from average.
In der Extra-Welle Goldene Eier auf den: In the Xtrawave, throw Golden Eggs at the King Salmonid instead of only shooting – the egg throws deal most of the damage.
Bosse dort töten, wo sie spawnen (am Kar: Killing bosses where they spawn (at the map edge) – the eggs then lie unreachably far away.
Eier einzeln über die halbe Karte tragen: Carrying eggs one by one across half the map instead of luring bosses or throwing.
Allein am Kartenrand farmen, außer Reich: Farming alone at the map edge, out of range of any rescue.
Kleine Salmoniden tunneln, während Flyfi: Tunnel-visioning small salmonids while Flyfish and Stinger tear the team apart.
Ausgefallene Kollegen liegen lassen, „we: Leaving downed teammates lying 'because there's no time right now'.
Beide Spezialwaffen-Einsätze bis zum Sch: Hoarding both special uses until the end (and sinking with them) – or burning both in wave 1.
Nach erfüllter Quote aufhören zu liefern: Stopping deliveries once the quota is met instead of building a buffer for the next wave.
Bei Flut auf der überfluteten Fläche ste: Standing on the flooded area at high tide, not going out at low tide (eggs given away).
Wo steht er die meiste Zeit?: Where does he stand most of the time?
Zähle beim Zuschauen mit: Wie oft ist er: Count along while watching: how often is he more than ~3 seconds of walking away from the basket? Top players spend 70–80% of the time in the middle area – even while farming.
Was macht er, wenn ein Boss spawnt?: What does he do when a boss spawns?
Er tötet ihn fast nie sofort am Spawn-Pu: He almost never kills it right at the spawn point – he waits until the boss is closer to the basket, or actively LURES it there. Count how many bosses he finishes next to the basket.
Wann und wie liefert er Eier ab?: When and how does he deliver eggs?
Er trägt selten weit – er WIRFT Eier Ric: He rarely carries far – he THROWS eggs toward the basket and collects in bursts (first drop bosses, then deliver 2–3 eggs in a row). Watch the egg throws!
Was macht er als Erstes bei Flut oder Eb: What's the first thing he does at high or low tide?
Er repositioniert sich SOFORT, bevor die: He repositions IMMEDIATELY, before the wave really starts – out to the water at low tide, onto the safe platform early at high tide. The tide never surprises him.
Wie schnell reagiert er auf ausgefallene: How fast does he react to downed teammates?
Stoppuhr im Kopf: Wie viele Sekunden ver: Stopwatch in your head: how many seconds until a nearby teammate is revived? Usually under 3 – he'll drop eggs for it if he has to.
Wann zündet er die Spezialwaffe?: When does he fire his special weapon?
Nicht erst, wenn er fast tot ist – sonde: Not when he's almost dead – but BEFORE the situation tips (many bosses at once, quota wobbling). Note in which wave he spends his 2 uses.
